name: Motor Vehicle Collisions - Person
description:
This dataset contains person-level records from motor vehicle collisions, with one row per person involved in a crash. Each record links a person to a collision and, where applicable, a vehicle, and includes crash timing, person type (occupant, pedestrian, bicyclist, or other motorized), injury status, age, sex, ejection status, emotional state, bodily injury details, seating position, safety equipment use, pedestrian location and action, complaints, role in the crash, and up to two contributing factors. The sample covers 5,000 people across roughly 1,500 collisions over a seven-day period in November 2026. Many fields are sparsely populated or marked "Does Not Apply," and person_age contains placeholder values such as 999999 that require cleaning.

The data supports analyses of crash patterns by time of day, person type, and demographics; injury severity and body region outcomes; safety equipment effectiveness; and contributing factors such as driver inattention or failure to yield. It can
